hypothesis: In some types of non-Alzheimer's, non-aged human brain cells, for example astrocytes, APOE4 causes reduced endosome pH compared with APOE3.

paper.title: Amyloid clearance defect in ApoE4 astrocytes is reversed by epigenetic correction of endosomal pH.
paper.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

findings.finding_description: Endosomal pH was measured ratiometrically with pH-sensitive TFN-FITC plus pH-insensitive TFN-633 in ApoE-knockout mouse astrocytes with isogenic knock-in of human ApoE3 or ApoE4. Endosomal pH was ~0.84 units lower (more acidic) in ApoE4 than in ApoE3 astrocytes.
findings.quote: Endosomal pH in ApoE4 astrocytes was strongly reduced by ∼0.84 pH unit, relative to ApoE3 (Fig. 3B).
findings.summary: ApoE4 knock-in astrocytes have endosomes ~0.84 pH units more acidic than ApoE3 astrocytes.
findings.experimental_system: ApoE-knockout mouse astrocytes with isogenic knock-in of human ApoE3 vs ApoE4 (cultured)

findings.finding_description: Endosomal pH was compared in fibroblasts from an ApoE4/4 AD patient and an age-matched ApoE3/3 control. ApoE4/4 endosomes showed acidification similar to that seen in the astrocytes. These are human cells, but non-brain cells from an AD patient.
findings.quote: A similar acidification was observed in endosomes of ApoE4/4 patient fibroblasts, compared with an ApoE3/3 control (SI Appendix, Fig. S2E).
findings.summary: Human ApoE4/4 AD-patient fibroblasts also show endosomal hyperacidification relative to an ApoE3/3 control.
findings.experimental_system: AD patient-derived human ApoE4/4 fibroblasts vs age-matched ApoE3/3 control fibroblasts

findings.finding_description: Lysosomal pH was measured with pHrodo-green-dextran normalized to Dextran-647 in the ApoE3 and ApoE4 knock-in astrocytes. Lysosomal pH was elevated by more than 1 unit in ApoE4, the opposite direction to the endosomal change. This shows the acidification is compartment-specific, not a global shift in acidic organelles.
findings.quote: (C) Lysosomal pH was elevated by >1 pH unit in ApoE4 astrocytes (***P = 0.0009, Student’s t test; n = 3).
findings.summary: ApoE4 astrocytes have more alkaline lysosomes (>1 pH unit), contrasting with their acidified endosomes.
findings.experimental_system: ApoE-knockout mouse astrocytes with human ApoE3 vs ApoE4 knock-in

findings.finding_description: Cytoplasmic pH was measured with ratiometric BCECF in ApoE3 vs ApoE4 knock-in astrocytes and did not differ. This null result indicates the endosomal acidification is not explained by a change in cytosolic pH.
findings.quote: (D) Cytoplasmic pH showed no significant (NS) differences between ApoE3 and ApoE4 astrocytes (P = 0.2904, Student’s t test; n = 3).
findings.summary: Cytoplasmic pH does not differ between ApoE3 and ApoE4 astrocytes.
findings.experimental_system: ApoE-knockout mouse astrocytes with human ApoE3 vs ApoE4 knock-in

findings.finding_description: NHE6 protein, the endosomal proton-leak transporter, was ~45% lower in ApoE4 than in ApoE3 astrocytes by Western blot. This is a mechanistic surrogate for endosomal pH rather than a pH measurement.
findings.quote: NHE6 protein was concomitantly decreased by ∼45% in ApoE4 astrocytes, compared with ApoE3 (Fig. 4C).
findings.summary: ApoE4 astrocytes have ~45% less NHE6 protein, consistent with reduced endosomal proton leak.
findings.experimental_system: ApoE-knockout mouse astrocytes with human ApoE3 vs ApoE4 knock-in

findings.finding_description: NHE6 transcript was measured by qPCR in ApoEKO, ApoE3 knock-in and ApoE4 knock-in astrocytes. It was ~56% lower specifically in ApoE4 cells, a transcriptional surrogate for reduced endosomal alkalinizing capacity.
findings.quote: Although the NHE6 transcript was similar in ApoEKO mouse astrocytes and ApoEKO astrocytes with knock-in of human ApoE3, it was ∼56% reduced in ApoE4 knock-in cells (SI Appendix, Fig. S5E).
findings.summary: NHE6 mRNA is ~56% lower in ApoE4 astrocytes than in ApoE3 or ApoEKO astrocytes.
findings.experimental_system: ApoE-knockout mouse astrocytes with human ApoE3 vs ApoE4 knock-in

findings.finding_description: In ApoE4 astrocytes, transcripts for endosomal NHE9 and the lysosomal V-ATPase V0a1 subunit were also reduced, while plasma-membrane NHE1 was unchanged. The V-ATPase reduction would by itself predict less acidification, so this result partly complicates a simple acid-loading model.
findings.quote: There was also an ApoE4-specific reduction in the transcript for the related endosomal isoform NHE9 (∼70% lower) and the lysosomal V-ATPase V0a1 subunit (∼67%), but not for the plasma membrane NHE1 isoform (SI Appendix, Fig. S5F).
findings.summary: ApoE4 astrocytes have lower NHE9 (~70%) and V-ATPase V0a1 (~67%) transcripts but unchanged NHE1.
findings.experimental_system: ApoE-knockout mouse astrocytes with human ApoE3 vs ApoE4 knock-in

findings.finding_description: Monensin (Na+/H+ ionophore; 50 μM, 1 h) raised endosomal pH in ApoE4 astrocytes from 5.38 to 5.74, which also gives the absolute ApoE4 baseline pH. Class 5: APOE genotype was not varied within this experiment; it tests whether the ApoE4 endosomal pH defect can be pharmacologically reversed.
findings.quote: Thus, monensin treatment (50 μM for 1 h) elevated endosomal pH in ApoE4 knock-in astrocytes from 5.38 ± 0.01–5.74 ± 0.03, relative to the vehicle-treated control (Fig. 3E)
findings.summary: Monensin alkalinizes the hyperacidic ApoE4 astrocyte endosomes (pH 5.38 to 5.74).

findings.finding_description: Ectopic wild-type NHE6 alkalinized endosomes in ApoE4 astrocytes, whereas Christianson-syndrome NHE6 mutants (L188P, G383D) did not. Class 5: APOE genotype was not perturbed; the experiment manipulates the proposed mediator to test whether NHE6 loss underlies the ApoE4 endosomal acidification.
findings.quote: Like monensin, NHE6 alkalinized the endosomal lumen in ApoE4 astrocytes, but the CS patient mutations did not (SI Appendix, Fig. S6H).
findings.summary: Restoring functional NHE6 corrects endosomal hyperacidification in ApoE4 astrocytes.
findings.experimental_system: Human ApoE4 knock-in mouse astrocytes transfected with GFP-NHE6 or CS mutants

findings.finding_description: The HDAC inhibitor TSA (5 μM, 12 h), which restores NHE6 expression, raised endosomal pH in ApoE4 astrocytes relative to DMSO. Class 5: genotype was not varied; this tests reversibility of the ApoE4 endosomal acidification through an upstream regulator.
findings.quote: (D) HDAC inhibition by TSA treatment (5 μM for 12 h) corrected hyperacidic endosomal pH in ApoE4 astrocytes, relative to DMSO treatment (**P = 0.0014, Student’s t test; n = 3).
findings.summary: TSA corrects hyperacidic endosomal pH in ApoE4 astrocytes.

findings.finding_description: In human AD fibroblasts, ApoE4/4 cells showed gene-expression changes (including NHE6) similar to those in ApoE4 astrocytes, relative to age-matched ApoE3/3 control fibroblasts. NHE6 expression serves here as a surrogate for endosomal pH regulation.
findings.quote: Similar changes in gene expression were observed in AD patient-derived ApoE4/4 fibroblasts compared with ApoE3/3 fibroblasts from age-matched control (SI Appendix, Fig. S2 F–H).
findings.summary: ApoE4/4 patient fibroblasts also show NHE6-related expression changes.
findings.experimental_system: AD patient-derived human ApoE4/4 vs ApoE3/3 fibroblasts

findings.finding_description: Reanalysis of a human postmortem brain microarray dataset (GSE15222) showed lower NHE6 transcript in ApoE4+ AD brains. This is aged, AD bulk tissue, and NHE6 is only a surrogate for endosomal pH.
findings.quote: Box plots of NHE6 transcript levels in postmortem brains extracted from a large microarray dataset (GSE15222; n = 363) showing significant down-regulation of NHE6 expression in ApoE4+ AD brains (****P = 1.2 × 10−10, Student’s t test).
findings.summary: NHE6 mRNA is reduced in ApoE4+ AD human brains.
findings.experimental_system: Human postmortem brain tissue (aged/AD), microarray dataset GSE15222

findings.finding_description: HDAC4 colocalized more with nuclear DAPI in ApoE4 than in ApoE3 astrocytes. This is a proposed upstream mechanism for NHE6 downregulation and only a distal surrogate for endosomal pH.
findings.quote: Pearson’s correlation coefficient for ApoE3: 0.17 ± 0.01 vs. ApoE4: 0.51 ± 0.02; ****P = 4.6 × 10−44, Student’s t test; n = 150 per condition
findings.summary: ApoE4 astrocytes show increased nuclear HDAC4, proposed to repress NHE6.
findings.experimental_system: ApoE-knockout mouse astrocytes with human ApoE3 vs ApoE4 knock-in
